[NFCT.4.4.3] The **`KEY`-tuple comparison is always exact**. On a `MUTABLE`
numeric slot a per-slot `tolerance` ([NFCT.1.4]) widens the *meaningful-change*
test — a within-tolerance payload change is a no-op and the live fact is kept.
`tolerance` is admissible only on `MUTABLE` slots; on a `KEY` slot it is a
compile error ([LGRA.5.9]) — identity is exact.
